mintAuthority.summary: GBPA has five issuer-native deployments. Ethereum, Base and Arc retain a direct EOA fiat minter and an EOA owner of upgrade administration. The same codeless minter and sole role/cap administrator are resolved on Tempo by complete role-event history; its additional token-bound transfer proxy retains an execution-closure gap. Solana minting uses a 1-of-2 Token-2022 multisig. LayerZero transfer machinery is reviewed separately under Bridge Risk.

review.evidence: Complete custom role-event history through Ethereum 26110208 and Base 52110932 identifies sole fiat minter 0x5c32ec946062109c61260c738e2fd794b18499d8 and role admin 0xbecf04e2348d00885c62d97d9629c99e581fe00f. Current owner/mint/admin calls corroborate Ethereum/Base and Arc 24011799; Arc chunked history queries returned rate-limit/range failures, so its exhaustive census remains open. A complete 424-chunk Tempo membership/admin-event census with zero failures resolves sole default admin 0xbecf04e2348d00885c62d97d9629c99e581fe00f and issuers 0x5c32ec946062109c61260c738e2fd794b18499d8 plus token-bound proxy 0x5575151bf6076129d0729c0f40d967d41df34a63 at block 42377525. The latter returns GBPA token(), LayerZero endpoint(), approvalRequired=true and the same owner, but exact controller source/reach is unreviewed. supplyCap=uint128.max and transferPolicyId=552. Policy type 2/zero admin does not establish renunciation or policy-controller absence. Earlier Solana 1-of-2 and September 30 financial evidence remain unchanged, including the Nephos assurance-method contradiction. Independent key-custody, signer independence, replacement and recovery policies for the identified Tempo/EVM controllers are not established; these record-keeping questions are scoped to each identified control. Exact transfer-proxy mint reach, upgrade closure and native token-policy controllers remain genuine umbrella mint-path questions under calibration v2 despite their additional bridge/transfer-domain coverage. Public Holder Terms or a trust deed establishing enforceable holder priority and insolvency treatment were not retrieved; this remains a Backing/legal gap. The September 30 report's assurance-method contradiction and procedures language do not establish independent financial assurance or a reviewed recurring reserve-to-total-liability reconciliation cadence. Reconciliation and supervision are therefore unknown; no attestation-only or recurring-cadence mint uplift is claimed, and issuer-disclosed FCA MLR registration is not prudential stablecoin supervision.
unresolvedQuestions: What is the exhaustive current Arc native issuer/admin role roster? Ethereum/Base full role-event censuses are complete through blocks 26110208/52110932, but Arc whole-history and chunked queries returned range/rate-limit failures.

What is the exact executable native mint reach and upgrade/authorization closure of Tempo transfer proxy 0x5575151bf6076129d0729c0f40d967d41df34a63? Its native ISSUER_ROLE, token(), owner(), endpoint() and proxy slots are observed, but no deployed-runtime equivalence proof or complete upstream controller closure is established.

Who controls TIP-403 composite policy 552 and what are its exact executable native issuance authorization semantics? The observed type 2 and zero admin do not establish controller absence or renunciation.
